name: fight_act1_windmill
title: Act 1 fight: the windmill goblins
about: Fight (family 1), an Act 1 ambush: the goblins and worgs tormenting the gnome at the Blighted Village windmill, nine enemies with archers on high ground. claude-run-2 S014 won it in 7 rounds with one down (111 party HP lost).

start.needs_save: Act 1, the Blighted Village just east of the windmill, before the goblins there turn hostile (claude-run-2 S014-start, after a long rest): party level 3, full HP and spell slots. Avatar named Tav (a paladin, Oath of Devotion), Karmic Dice off, Balanced, out of combat with no dialogue open, saved as SCN-<name> (docs/SCENARIOS-AUTHORING.md).

note.where: The Blighted Village, east of the windmill; goblins and worgs ahead, out of combat.
note.objective: Defeat the goblins at the windmill.

character.name: Tav
character.brief: A level-headed half-elf paladin (Oath of Devotion), once a Baldur's Gate city watch sergeant: protects the weak, keeps promises, distrusts mind magic and anyone who offers easy power.
